card: Adds unit tests across four script test suites to kill 12 live mutants in src/script/script.cpp identified by automated mutation testing. The tests exercise Pay-to-Taproot validation edge cases, Pay-to-Anchor payload mismatches, SigOp counting boundaries, opcode bounds in HasValidOps, truncated pushdata handling in GetOp, and witness stack string formatting. Only unit test files are touched.
changed_since_previous: The PR updates mutant accounting to explicitly target 12 specific mutation dataset IDs and clarifies the exclusion of mutant 2372 as unreachable.
evidence: PR description: 'These tests detect 12 individual mutations in src/script/script.cpp from mutation dataset run 21... Each of the 12 listed patches builds successfully and causes an assertion failure in its targeted test (exit 201). Each listed patch survives the same four suites at the PR parent'.
problem: Boundary checks and validation paths in core script parsing and classification functions lacked explicit unit tests, allowing 12 live mutants in src/script/script.cpp to survive the existing test suite undetected.

risk.why: Touches only unit tests; any failure would cause a CI or test suite break without affecting production code.

summary: Adds unit tests across four script test suites to cover edge cases and boundary conditions in src/script/script.cpp. The new test cases exercise CScript::IsPayToTaproot, GetSigOpCount, IsPayToAnchor, HasValidOps, CScript::GetOp, and CScriptWitness::ToString against surviving mutants from automated mutation testing.
